dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: You must have a sharp mind if you managed to solve all three riddles.

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: Um, so... Although typically the one who solves the riddles gets free Xiao Lanterns, I'm afraid I simply can't give you these Xiao Lanterns here...

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: And it would ruin my hands if I were to try and make three more. Ahem... Please take these instead.

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: These children don't seem ready to stop just yet... It seems like three riddles was not enough. I'll have to come up with a few more.

response.speaker: Qingzhou
response.text: Oh, don't read too much into it... That was just a little idea I came up with, it's nothing serious.

response.speaker: Qingzhou
response.text: But these children are waiting very expectantly for me to give them lantern riddles.

response.speaker: Qingzhou
response.text: I'll keep entertaining them until they've had enough. When the painter comes, I'll let him know.

response.speaker: Qingzhou
response.text: Ah, would you look at the time? Wang'ya should be arriving any moment now. Please, could you receive her on my behalf? I shall continue entertaining these children with lantern riddles.
